purpose: Perform one final pre-outcome source-coverage expansion for the locked MF, institutional-FPI and institutional-breadth Smart Money mappings without changing evidence semantics, scoring bands or the minimum holdout cohort.
reason_for_expansion: The frozen 100-company diagnosis had 13 all-three five-period mapping-complete companies, below the minimum 30, and revealed irregular five-period spans. Expansion is based only on pre-outcome source coverage and chronology diagnostics; no future prices or returns have been loaded.

base_sample.rule: Recompute and preserve the exact original sample; abort if its identity hash changes.

extension_sample.rule: Select outcome-blind from the anchor universe after excluding every base-sample ISIN; no overlap permitted.

span_rule_source: Reuse the frozen 4Q chronology guard from validation/2023/promoter_accumulation_protocol_v1.json rather than treating irregular five-filing sequences as four quarters.

component_completeness.mf_holding_change_pp_4q: Locked MF mapping must be unambiguous in all five selected periods and the first-to-last period span must be 330-400 days.
component_completeness.fii_holding_change_pp_4q: Locked institutional-FPI mapping must be unambiguous in all five selected periods and the first-to-last period span must be 330-400 days.
component_completeness.institutional_breadth_change_4q: Locked aggregate institutional shareholder-count mapping must be unambiguous in all five selected periods and the first-to-last period span must be 330-400 days.

decision_rule: Proceed to a separately preregistered Smart Money outcome holdout only if at least 30 companies have all three locked components complete across five safe periods spanning 330-400 days. Otherwise stop the historical source path before outcome load.
